title: AiaProtocol
description: AI Autonomy engine-frontend protocol (docs/engine-plan.md §4.8). One WebSocket at /ws carries JSON text frames discriminated by `type`. The hybrid game contract (docs/contract.md) adds the REST bodies under /api/maps, /api/runs and /api/catalogs. Generated from aiautonomy.engines.api.protocol and aiautonomy.engines.contract; do not edit.

Access.description: Where a building's or facility's driveway joins the road network.
Access.title: Access

AckMessage.description: The immediate answer to exactly one command.
AckMessage.title: AckMessage

ActionOption.description: One permitted mayor action, derived from the recorded incident and unit state.
ActionOption.title: ActionOption

Assignment.description: A unit committed to an incident; the game starts moving it at `effective_tick`.

travel_ticks.description: As reported by the game graph.

Assignment.title: Assignment

AuthorityChange.description: One change of political authority (0–100). Satisfaction never changes authority.
AuthorityChange.title: AuthorityChange

Bounds.description: World extent in meters; x points east, y north, origin at the map center.
Bounds.title: Bounds

CancelCommand.description: End the current run as interrupted (END-05).
CancelCommand.title: CancelCommand

ClockView.description: Simulated clock after the latest completed tick.

tick.description: Completed ticks; 0 before the first tick.

ClockView.title: ClockView

ConfigureCommand.description:
Create a fresh idle run (new run_id, run_epoch + 1); only when not running or paused.
A snapshot follows the ack.
ConfigureCommand.title: ConfigureCommand

apply_tick.description: Fixed at request time; never wall-clock dependent.

DecisionMessage.description: A recorded model decision (first emitted in M4/M5).
DecisionMessage.title: DecisionMessage

DecisionRecord.description: A model decision outcome (placeholder until M4/M5).
DecisionRecord.title: DecisionRecord

DeltaMessage.description:
Changes since the previous delta; `state_version` is exactly one higher. At max speed
one delta may cover several ticks.
DeltaMessage.title: DeltaMessage

DisruptionEffects.description: Physical effects the game applies while the disruption is active.

speed_multiplier_bp.description: Travel speed in scope, basis points (10000 = unchanged).

closes_roads.description: Close every road segment within the radius.

closes_tunnels.description: Close tunnel segments within the radius.

closes_low_roads.description: Close segments below ground level in radius.

signals_out.description: Traffic signals in the radius behave as stop signs.

mayor_office_outage.description: The mayor is offline while active if the mayor office is in scope.

DisruptionEffects.title: DisruptionEffects

duplicate.description: True when this request_id was already accepted.

DisruptionRecord.description: A disruption of record. Severity = template severity × intensity / 50, clamped.

incident_id.description: Id the game must give the spawned incident.

DisruptionRecord.title: DisruptionRecord

DisruptionSpec.description: A scheduled or injected disruption; omitted values take the catalog defaults.

at_tick.description: Start tick; omitted for injection = next tick boundary.

DisruptionSpec.title: DisruptionSpec

EpochRequest.description: Body of `reset` and `cancel`; the epoch must match the run's.
EpochRequest.title: EpochRequest

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every 4xx answer from the hybrid REST API.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FixedGeometry.description: Read-only geometry owned by the game, pinned by the SHA-256 of its source file.
FixedGeometry.title: FixedGeometry

IncidentObservation.description: One incident as the game sees it. Report it with `resolved` once before dropping it.
IncidentObservation.title: IncidentObservation

IncidentTemplate.description: The incident the game spawns for the disruption (id = the record's `incident_id`).
IncidentTemplate.title: IncidentTemplate

InspectCommand.description: Look up one entity; the ack's `result` holds it.
InspectCommand.title: InspectCommand

radius.description: Footprint radius; null derives it from type.

area.description: A fixed famous district cluster (locked, never removable).

mayor_office.description: Landmark or facility housing the mayor; an Outage covering it takes the mayor offline.

MapCreateRequest.description: `POST /api/maps`: save a new map (revision 1), optionally derived from `parent`.
MapCreateRequest.title: MapCreateRequest

MapFacility.description: A police (PD), fire (FD) or medical facility with its units.

landmark.description: Set when the facility occupies a landmark site (e.g. MGH).

MapFacility.title: MapFacility

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `content`.

unlocked.description: User landmarks this revision unlocked through an explicit setup action.

MapRevisionRequest.description: `POST /api/maps/{id}/revisions`: save the next revision; `base` must be the latest.
MapRevisionRequest.title: MapRevisionRequest

MapRoad.description: A straight road segment between two nodes (the game's `a`/`b` endpoints).

b.description: End node id; one-way roads run from `a` to `b`.

MapRoad.title: MapRoad

MapValidateRequest.description: `POST /api/maps/validate`: dry run; with `base` the lock rules are checked too.
MapValidateRequest.title: MapValidateRequest

MayorDecisionRecord.description: One mayor decision from request to outcome (`decisions.jsonl`).

missed_opportunities.description: Opportunities skipped during the same outage (one hold).

MayorDecisionRecord.title: MayorDecisionRecord

MayorProposal.description: The model's structured answer: one option id plus an optional public statement.
MayorProposal.title: MayorProposal

MetricsMessage.description: Metric values after `tick`; sent once per published delta.
MetricsMessage.title: MetricsMessage

MoverView.description: A moving entity; position in meters.
MoverView.title: MoverView

OrderAuthority.description: The political cost of one accepted order (rolling allowance and penalty).

counted.description: False for a repeat of the same order key in the window.

window_count.description: Distinct accepted orders in the window.

OrderAuthority.title: OrderAuthority

OrderOutcome.description: Measured outcome, filled from later game observations.
OrderOutcome.title: OrderOutcome

OrderRecord.description: An exceptional department-level order with its origin, units, outcome and cost.
OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord

PauseCommand.description: Pause a running run at the next tick boundary.
PauseCommand.title: PauseCommand

threshold.description: Unique signers needed to call a recall vote.

participants.description: Unique residents in the protest movement.

active.description: At least the rule's minimum participants.

QueueEntry.description: Unmet demand of one department at one incident.
QueueEntry.title: QueueEntry

Recovery.description: How the disruption ends and what persists.

mode.description: `on_duration`: ends after duration_ticks. `on_clear`: ends when the responding units clear the incident (or after duration_ticks at the latest). `gradual`: after duration_ticks, speed stays at gradual_speed_multiplier_bp for gradual_ticks.

lasting.description: Consequences that persist after the end.

Recovery.title: Recovery

Release.description: A unit back in service after its incident was cleared or resolved.
Release.title: Release

RemoveChange.description: Remove the entity `id` from the keyed map `collection`.
RemoveChange.title: RemoveChange

ResetCommand.description:
Abandon the current run (interrupted if it had started), cancel in-flight work and
create a fresh idle run with the same configuration. A snapshot follows the ack.
ResetCommand.title: ResetCommand

ResidentAction.description: A resident decision, delivered in the outcome of its apply tick.

fallback.description: True when the model failed: routine behaviour.

ResidentAction.title: ResidentAction

ResidentDecisionRequest.description: `POST /api/runs/{run_id}/residents`: LLM residents only, at most eight per request.

tick.description: The last tick the game posted; decisions apply at +2.

ResidentDecisionRequest.title: ResidentDecisionRequest

ResidentObservation.description: What one LLM resident sees (RES-05): own state, local conditions, no hidden events.
ResidentObservation.title: ResidentObservation

RouteObservation.description: Route availability from a unit's position to an incident on the current game graph.
RouteObservation.title: RouteObservation

RunConfigOverrides.description: Run configuration overrides; omitted fields keep the scenario defaults.
RunConfigOverrides.title: RunConfigOverrides

tick.description: Last processed tick (0 before the first).

scheduled_disruptions.description: Launch-scheduled disruptions (automatic ones stay hidden until they start).

RunLaunchRequest.description: `POST /api/runs`: launch a run pinned to one map revision.
RunLaunchRequest.title: RunLaunchRequest

RunState.description: Lifecycle state of a run. `completed`, `removed` and `interrupted` are terminal.
RunState.title: RunState

RunStatus.description: Playback and lifecycle status of the current run.

ticks_per_second.description: Nominal playback rate: 5 at 1x, 10 at 2x, 20 at 4x, 0 at max (unpaced).

waiting_for_inference.description: True while the driver waits for inference before phase 4 of a tick.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus

RunStatusMessage.description: Sent on connect and whenever any field of the run status changes.
RunStatusMessage.title: RunStatusMessage

SetChange.description: Replace the top-level singleton `field` of the world view (for example `clock`).
SetChange.title: SetChange

SetSpeedCommand.description: Change the playback speed; applies from the next tick boundary.
SetSpeedCommand.title: SetSpeedCommand

SnapshotMessage.description: Full world view; replaces all client state for `run_id`.
SnapshotMessage.title: SnapshotMessage

Speed.description: Playback speed. `max` runs ticks back to back without wall-clock pacing.
Speed.title: Speed

StepCommand.description: Advance exactly one tick; only when idle or paused (the run is paused afterwards).
StepCommand.title: StepCommand

SyncCommand.description: Request a fresh snapshot, sent after the ack.
SyncCommand.title: SyncCommand

TelemetryCommand.description: Client performance samples, kept in memory for benchmark reports.
TelemetryCommand.title: TelemetryCommand

TickObservation.description: `POST /api/runs/{run_id}/ticks`: what the game observed after simulating `tick`.

routes.description: Every (available unit, unresolved incident) pair, including units a `cleared` event in this observation frees; see docs/contract.md §4.

TickObservation.title: TickObservation

TickOutcome.description: The engine's answer for one tick; effects apply in the game from `effective_tick`.

resident_modes.description: Mode of residents who joined this tick (true = LLM).

TickOutcome.title: TickOutcome

UnitEvent.description: A physical outcome: a unit reached its incident, or finished its service there.
UnitEvent.title: UnitEvent

UnitSpec.description: A service unit based at a facility; its department is the facility's.
UnitSpec.title: UnitSpec

UnitView.description: The engine's view of one unit after the tick.
UnitView.title: UnitView

UpsertChange.description: Insert or replace the whole entity `id` in the keyed map `collection`.
UpsertChange.title: UpsertChange

WorldView.description:
Renderable world state. Keyed maps (`movers`) are the collections that `upsert` and
`remove` changes address; other top-level fields are singletons replaced by `set`.
WorldView.title: WorldView
